meta.purpose: The How-to screen for every exercise in claude/app-data.json: steps, what to watch for, demo photos and a demo video. Keyed by the same exercise ids.
meta.photos: From free-exercise-db (public domain, The Unlicense). Each set is two photos, <photoBase><photos>/0.jpg and /1.jpg, showing the two ends of the movement; the How-to screen shows them side by side above the steps. All 37 sets were checked by eye on 23 Nov. The build copies the photos into the app.
meta.videos: YouTube, played inside the How-to screen (needs internet). <videoBase><video.id>. Reviewed and accepted by Chris on 23 Nov (CrossFit muscle-up negative swapped out; Yellow Dude used where he has a proper tutorial). Closed: only change a video if Chris flags it.
meta.steps: Written for this program: its cues, the 90° knee cap and the back rules. Not copied from the photo set.

steps: Stand tall and hold the band at chest height with straight arms, hands about shoulder-width.
Pull the band apart until it touches your chest, squeezing your shoulder blades together. Return slowly.
watchFor: Shrugging your shoulders up
Leaning back or flaring your ribs

steps: Hold the band wide in front of your hips with straight arms.
Lift it up, over your head and down behind your back in one slow arc, then bring it back the same way. Widen your grip if you have to bend your elbows.
watchFor: Bending your elbows to get through
Arching your lower back as the band goes overhead

video.title: How To Do Band Dislocates / Pass-Throughs (Shoulder Mobility)

steps: Push-up position, arms locked, body in a straight line.
Without bending your elbows, let your chest sink so your shoulder blades pinch together. Then push the floor away until your upper back rounds slightly.
watchFor: Bending your elbows
Hips sagging

video.title: The Perfect Scapula Push-Up!

steps: On hands and knees, palms flat, fingers pointing forward. Rock your shoulders gently forward over your hands and back, about 10 times.
Turn your hands so your fingers point at your knees and rock back toward your heels, about 10 times.
A few gentle rocks on the backs of your hands, then wrist circles.
watchFor: Forcing into pain. This is a warm-up, not a stretch.

video.title: Wrist Strength & Mobility Exercises

steps: Band pull-aparts 2 × 15, then band dislocates 1 × 10. Each has its own how-to.
Lie on your back, press your lower back into the floor, lift your shoulders and legs a few centimetres and hold for 10 seconds. If your back stays flat, you're set for handstands.
watchFor: Lower back lifting off the floor

video.title: HOLLOW BODY HOLD Progressions (Beginner to Advanced)

steps: Start in a push-up with your feet at the wall. Walk your feet up the wall and your hands in until your chest faces the wall.
Arms locked, push tall through your shoulders, ribs down, glutes squeezed, toes resting lightly on the wall. Look at the floor between your hands.
Walk your hands out and your feet down while you still have a few seconds left in you.
watchFor: Arching your back into a banana shape
Shoulders sinking toward your ears instead of pushing tall
Holding until your arms give out

video.title: Most people learn handstands wrong
video.note: Whole handstand progression. Chest-to-wall is one of the steps.

steps: Walk your feet a short way up the wall so you're in a low, angled handstand.
Shift your weight onto one hand, turn your hips and step the opposite foot down to the side, like the end of a cartwheel. Land one foot at a time.
Practise bailing to both sides until it's automatic.
watchFor: Dropping both feet at once
Landing with a twist on the right knee. Step down, don't pivot.

video.title: How to Bail Out of the Handstand with a Cartwheel or Pirouette

steps: Backpack on tight (dip belt or DB at the gym). Hang with straight arms, hands just wider than your shoulders.
Pull your shoulder blades down first, then drive your elbows to your ribs until your chin clears the bar.
Lower under control to straight arms. Step down onto a box or chair to finish.
watchFor: Kipping or swinging
Half reps. Start every rep from straight arms.
Dropping off the bar onto your knee

steps: Hands and feet on the floor, hips high so your body makes an upside-down V. Hands shoulder-width.
Bend your elbows at about 45° and lower your head to the floor ahead of your hands, taking 2–3 seconds.
Push back up to the start, finishing with your head between your arms.
watchFor: Elbows flaring straight out to the sides
Head landing between your hands instead of ahead of them
Hips dropping so it turns into a normal push-up

video.title: It looks like a push-up. Your hips disagree.

steps: Push-up position with your hands close together under your chest, thumbs and index fingers nearly touching.
Lower your chest to your hands with your elbows brushing your ribs.
Push up to locked arms with your body in one straight line.
watchFor: Hips sagging or piking up
Elbows flaring wide
Wrist pain. Move your hands a little further apart.

steps: Lie with your eyes under the bar, feet flat, shoulder blades pulled back and down. Grip just wider than your shoulders.
Unrack, then lower the bar to your mid-chest with your elbows about 45° from your body.
Press up and slightly back until your arms lock. Rack it only after the last rep is locked out.
watchFor: Bouncing the bar off your chest
Your bum lifting off the bench
Going heavy without a spotter or safety bars

steps: Lie under the dip bar, grip it and hang with straight arms, heels on the floor, body straight.
Pull your chest to the bar, squeezing your shoulder blades together.
Lower slowly to straight arms. Bend your knees to make it easier or raise your feet to make it harder.
watchFor: Hips sagging
Shrugging, or leading with your chin

steps: Head level. Press your hand into your forehead and resist so your head doesn't move. Hold 10–15 seconds at about half effort. Repeat with your hand on the back of your head.
Do the same with your hand on the left side of your head, then the right.
watchFor: Pushing so hard your head moves
Holding your breath

steps: Lie on your back with a rolled towel across your upper back, just below your shoulder blades. Knees bent, hands behind your head.
Let your upper back drape back over the towel and breathe out slowly. Keep your ribs down and your bum on the floor.
After 20–30 seconds, shift the towel a few centimetres higher and repeat.
watchFor: Arching from your lower back instead of your upper back
Chin poking forward

video.title: CM | Thoracic Extension - Foam Roller
video.note: Shown on a foam roller. Your rolled towel works the same way.

steps: Kneel in front of a chair or the couch and put both elbows on it, hands together.
Sink your chest toward the floor and sit your hips back until you feel it down the sides of your back and under your arms. Breathe slowly.
watchFor: Arching your lower back to get lower. Keep your ribs down.

video.title: How To Do A Kneeling Lat Stretch On A Bench

steps: Kneel facing away from the couch or a wall with a pad under your back knee. Put that shin up the couch and step the other foot forward, flat on the floor.
Squeeze the glute of the back leg, pull your ribs down and tuck your pelvis under.
Only then bring your torso upright, until the stretch hits the front of the hip and thigh. Hold and breathe.
watchFor: Arching your lower back to get upright
Pain or pressure in the back knee. Add padding, or slide the knee further from the couch.

video.title: Couch Stretch for Hip Flexors and Quads

steps: Backpack on tight (dip belt or DB at the gym). Support yourself on the bars with locked arms and your shoulders pushed down away from your ears.
Lean slightly forward and bend your elbows until your shoulders are level with, or just below, your elbows.
Push back up to locked arms.
watchFor: Shoulders shrugging up at the bottom
Dropping fast into the bottom
Pain at the front of the shoulder. Stop a little higher.

steps: Set your wrists over the top of the bar so the heel of each palm sits on it, wrists bent, thumbs wrapped around.
Hang with straight arms and keep that bent-wrist grip for the whole hold. Put a box under your feet to take some weight if the grip slips.
watchFor: Wrists sliding back into a normal hang
Inner-elbow or wrist pain. Cut the hold short.

video.title: False Grip Progression | Build Strength for Muscle Ups
video.note: The last step in the video moves to rings. You stay on the bar.

steps: Get above the bar with locked arms: climb up via the dip bar at home, or step up from a box at the gym. Use a false grip.
Over 5 seconds, lean your chest over the bar, let your elbows travel back, and roll from the dip into the top of a pull-up. Keep the bar close to your chest.
Lower to straight arms, then step down.
watchFor: One elbow coming over before the other (chicken wing)
Dropping through the middle instead of controlling it
Elbow ache the next morning. Cut the reps.

video.title: Tutorial for Slow, Strict Bar Muscle up (No Kipping!)
video.note: Strict, feet-supported version on a low bar. Same slow lowering through the transition as the negative.

steps: Stand with your feet hip-width, the DB at your shoulder and your elbow under your wrist. Brace your stomach and squeeze your glutes.
Press straight up until your arm locks out beside your ear.
watchFor: Leaning back or sideways to get it up
Ribs flaring

steps: One hand and the same-side knee on a bench or the couch, back flat, the DB hanging straight down from the other hand.
Pull the DB to your hip, elbow close to your side.
Lower until your arm is straight, without letting your shoulder drop or your torso twist.
watchFor: Twisting your torso to heave it up
Your back rounding

steps: Sit with your forearm resting on your thigh, palm up, wrist just past your knee, holding the plate or kettlebell.
Curl your wrist up, then lower over 2–3 seconds until your hand hangs down.
watchFor: Forearm lifting off your thigh
Pain above 3/10

steps: Sit with your forearm resting on your thigh or a table, elbow bent to 90°, holding the kettlebell by its handle with your thumb up.
Slowly turn your palm down, come back to thumb-up, then turn your palm up. Take about 2 seconds each way.
watchFor: Your elbow lifting or swinging to help
Letting the weight flop at either end

video.title: Resisted Forearm Pronation and Supination - Dumbbell
video.note: Shown with a dumbbell. Same movement with your kettlebell.

steps: Loop a rubber band around the outside of all five fingertips.
Spread your fingers and thumb as wide as you can, hold for a second, and close slowly.
watchFor: Rushing. Slow reps work better.

video.title: Banded Finger Extension

steps: 5 minutes at an easy pace, just enough to warm your legs up.
On hands and knees, back flat, knees a little wider than your hips.
Push your hips back toward your heels while keeping your back flat, then return.
watchFor: Your lower back rounding as you go back
Going deeper than is pain-free and click-free for the right knee

video.title: Quadruped Rock Back - Hip Mobility Drill

steps: Hold a pole or door frame at chest height. Feet shoulder-width, toes turned out a little.
Sit down between your heels as deep as is comfortable, chest up, heels down, using the pole for balance.
Breathe and shift gently from side to side. Pull on the pole to stand up.
watchFor: Any pain or clicking in the right knee. Come up higher.
Heels lifting

video.title: Assisted Deep Squat

steps: Stand on one leg with a soft knee, hips level, eyes forward. Hold for 30 seconds.
Too easy? Turn your head from side to side, or close your eyes.
watchFor: Your hip dropping on the lifted side
The standing knee drifting inward

steps: Stand on one leg in front of a knee-height box or chair, the other leg held out in front, arms forward.
Lower slowly until you're sitting lightly on the box. Pause for 1 second without relaxing.
Drive through your whole foot and stand up without rocking.
watchFor: Knee collapsing inward
Dropping the last few centimetres onto the box
Using a lower box. It stays at knee height for now.

video.title: How to: Pistol Squat to Box

steps: Hips and lower back flat on the pad. Feet flat on the platform, about shoulder-width. Set the safety stop so your knees can't bend past 90°.
Lower under control until your knees reach 90°. Knees track over your toes and your hips stay down on the pad.
Push through your whole foot until your legs are almost straight. Don't snap your knees locked.
watchFor: Hips rolling up off the pad at the bottom (your lower back rounding)
Knees caving inward
Heels lifting off the platform

steps: Stand in the middle of the bar, feet hip-width. Push your hips back, bend your knees and grip the handles. Chest up, back flat, arms straight.
Take a breath, brace, and push the floor away. Stand tall and squeeze your glutes. Don't lean back at the top.
Hips back first, then bend your knees, and put the bar down under control. Reset your back before every rep.
watchFor: Lower back rounding. Use the high handles or raise the bar on plates.
Jerking the bar off the floor
Skipping the warm-up sets

video.title: Trap Bar Deadlift (Exercise Library)

steps: Stand holding the bar at your thighs, feet hip-width, knees soft.
Push your hips straight back and slide the bar down your thighs with a flat back until you feel your hamstrings load, somewhere between knee and mid-shin.
Drive your hips forward to stand tall.
watchFor: Your back rounding at the bottom
The bar drifting away from your legs
Turning it into a squat

steps: Kneel on a pad with your heels locked under a loaded bar (gym) or the couch (home). At the gym, loop a band from the rack around your chest.
Keep a straight line from knees to head with your hips locked. Lower yourself toward the floor as slowly as you can.
Catch yourself with your hands and push back up to the start.
watchFor: Bending at the hips so your bum sticks out
Dropping fast through the last half
Cramp or sharp pain behind the knee. Stop the set.

video.title: Master The Nordic Hamstring Curl to Improve Your Hamstring Strength

steps: Set the hip pad just below your hip bones so you can hinge freely. Ankles locked in, arms crossed on your chest.
Hinge forward at the hips with a flat back.
Come up until your body is one straight line, and stop there.
watchFor: Arching past straight at the top
Rounding your back on the way down
Swinging

steps: Stand on a step on the ball of one foot with your heel hanging off. Keep a hand on the wall for balance.
Rise as high as you can and pause for a second.
Lower slowly until your heel is below the step.
watchFor: Bouncing out of the bottom
Rolling onto the outside of your foot
singleLegCalfRaise.photoNote: The photo shows both legs with dumbbells. You do one leg at a time, bodyweight.

steps: Lie on your side with your elbow under your shoulder. Rest the inside of your top knee on a bench or the couch. The bottom leg hangs free underneath.
Lift your hips until your body is straight from shoulders to knee, and bring the bottom leg up to meet the bench.
watchFor: Hips sagging or rolling forward
Pain on the inside of the right knee. Stop, and make sure the support is under the knee, not the foot.

video.title: Copenhagen Plank Short Lever

steps: Sit on the floor with one leg bent 90° in front of you and the other bent 90° out to the side, both shins resting down.
Sit tall, then hinge your chest forward over the front shin with a flat back until you feel the outside of that hip.
Hold and breathe, then change sides by lifting and placing your legs. Don't twist through your knees.
watchFor: The right knee twisting or clicking. Prop that hip on a cushion or ease off.
Rounding your back to get lower

video.title: 90 90 Hip Stretch (Best Hip Mobility Exercise!)

steps: From hands and knees, bring one knee forward behind your wrist with the shin angled across your body. Slide the other leg straight back.
Keep your hips level and facing the floor. Put a cushion under the front hip if it doesn't reach the ground.
Walk your hands forward and lower your chest until you feel the outside of the front hip.
watchFor: Pressure or twisting in the front knee. Bring that heel closer to your hip, add a cushion, or do a figure-4 stretch on your back instead.
Hips rolling to one side

video.title: Pigeon Stretch | Deep Hip & Glute Release for Athletes

steps: Half-kneel with a pad under your back knee, front foot flat, both knees at about 90°.
Squeeze the glute of the back leg, pull your ribs down and tuck your pelvis under.
Keeping the tuck, ease your hips forward a few centimetres until you feel the front of the back hip.
watchFor: Arching your lower back as you move forward
Feeling it in your back instead of the front of the hip

video.title: How to Stretch Both Your Hip Flexors (Tutorial)

steps: March on the spot with high knees and swinging arms for the time shown.
Feet shoulder-width, toes turned out slightly, arms out in front.
Sit down and back over 3 seconds until your thighs are parallel to the floor.
Stand up through your whole foot.
watchFor: Going below parallel
Knees caving in
Heels lifting
bodyweightSquat.photoNote: The photo may show a deeper squat. Yours stops at parallel.

steps: Loop a band around a table leg or post at knee height and step one leg into it so it sits behind that knee. Step back until the band is tight.
Let the band pull that knee slightly bent, heel on the floor.
Tighten your thigh to straighten the knee against the band and hold for 10 seconds. Do both legs.
watchFor: Forcing the right knee straight past a block
Leaning back instead of using your thigh

video.title: TKEs (Terminal Knee Extensions) (Exercise Library)

steps: Stand a long step in front of the couch or a bench and rest the top of your back foot on it. Hold the DB at your chest (home) or one in each hand (gym). Put a pad where your back knee will land.
Drop straight down until your front thigh is parallel to the floor and your back knee touches the pad.
Drive up through your front foot. Lean your torso slightly forward and keep the front knee tracking over your toes.
watchFor: Front thigh going below parallel
Front knee caving inward
Pushing off the back foot

video.title: The ULTIMATE Bulgarian Split Squat Tutorial
video.note: If the video goes deeper than parallel, your depth stop still applies.

steps: Stand on one leg with a soft knee, holding the DB in the opposite hand.
Push your hips back and let your free leg rise behind you as your chest lowers. Back flat, hips square to the floor. Go until you feel the hamstring of the standing leg.
Drive your hips forward to stand tall.
watchFor: Hips opening out to the side
Your back rounding to reach lower
The standing knee locking straight or bending a lot
singleLegRdl.photoNote: The photo uses a kettlebell. Same movement with your dumbbell.

video.title: Single Leg DB RDL (Exercise Library)

steps: Sit on the floor with your shoulder blades against the couch, feet flat and hip-width, the DB and plates resting in your hip crease.
Drive through your heels and lift your hips until you're level from shoulders to knees. Tuck your pelvis, squeeze your glutes for a second and keep your chin tucked.
watchFor: Arching your lower back at the top instead of tucking
Pushing through your toes
Feet too far away. You'll feel hamstrings, not glutes.
hipThrust.photoNote: The photo shows the barbell version on a bench. At home it's the same movement on the couch with the DB and plates.

steps: Lie on your back on a smooth floor with your heels on a towel, legs straight, arms by your sides.
Lift your hips into a bridge.
Keeping your hips up, drag your heels toward your bum, then slide them back out slowly.
watchFor: Hips dropping as your heels come in
Hamstrings cramping. Do only the slow slide out at first.

video.title: Exercise Tutorial: Hamstring Curl With Slider

steps: Side plank on your elbow with a straight body. Put your knees down if you need it easier.
Raise your top leg about 30–40 cm with your toes pointing forward, and hold it there for the time shown.
watchFor: Hips sagging or rolling backward
The top leg drifting forward

video.title: Side Plank Hip Abduction

steps: Pick the DB up in one hand like a suitcase, using your legs, and stand tall.
Walk 30 metres without leaning toward or away from the weight. Shoulders level.
Put it down using your legs, swap hands and walk back.
watchFor: Leaning to the side
Bending over with a rounded back to pick it up or put it down
suitcaseCarry.photoNote: The photo shows a weight in each hand. You carry one, on one side.

steps: Stand on a 10 cm step on your working leg with the other foot hanging off the front edge.
Bend the standing knee slowly until the other heel lightly taps the floor. Don't put weight on it.
watchFor: Knee collapsing inward
Your hip dropping on the free side
Any catching or pain in the knee. Use a lower step.

video.title: BULLETPROOF Your Knees With This Exercise!
video.note: They call it a touchdown squat and may use a higher box. Yours is 10 cm.

steps: On the dip bars, lock your arms and push your shoulders down away from your ears.
Lift your knees to hip height with your shins level, hips slightly behind your hands, pelvis tucked.
Hold 10–15 seconds, rest, and repeat until you've totalled 60 seconds.
watchFor: Shoulders shrugging up
Knees dropping below hip height
Your lower back pulling. Bring your knees in tighter.

video.title: L-SIT TUTORIAL | Step-by-Step Progressions to Master the Perfect L-Sit

steps: Get into your advanced tuck on the dip bars.
Straighten one leg out in front at hip height, knee locked, toes pointed. Keep the other knee tucked.
watchFor: The straight leg dropping
Leaning back to counterbalance
Bent arms

video.title: L-SIT TUTORIAL | Step-by-Step Progressions to Master the Perfect L-Sit

steps: Warm your wrists up well before this.
Stand at the dip bar and grip it. Bend your elbows and tuck them into your stomach at about belly-button height, with your hands under your elbows.
Breathe into your stomach, then lean forward so your elbows take some of your weight. Your feet stay on the floor. Hold 15–30 seconds.
watchFor: Wrist pain. This is the first drill to drop if it hurts.
Arching your lower back. Tuck your pelvis and squeeze your glutes.
Inner-elbow ache into the next morning. Cut the holds by a third to a half.

video.title: Learn the Elbow Lever in 1 Day | Elbow Lever Tutorial
video.note: Shows the full elbow lever. You're only doing the first part: the grip and the lean, feet down.

steps: Lie on your back and press your lower back into the floor.
Lift your shoulders and straight legs a few centimetres off the floor, arms by your sides or overhead.
Hold while breathing. If your lower back lifts, raise your legs higher or bend your knees.
watchFor: Lower back peeling off the floor
Chin jutting forward

video.title: HOLLOW BODY HOLD Progressions (Beginner to Advanced)

steps: Tie a band to a post at chest height. Stand side-on to it, holding the band at your chest with both hands, feet shoulder-width. Step away until it's tight.
Press your hands straight out in front of your chest and hold for 2 seconds without letting the band turn you.
Bring your hands back to your chest. Do all your reps, then face the other way.
watchFor: Your torso twisting toward the anchor
Hips shifting sideways
pallofPress.photoNote: The photo uses a cable machine. Your band does the same job.

steps: Hang from the bar with straight arms and your shoulders pulled down.
Tuck your pelvis under and bring your knees up toward your chest, curling your hips up at the top.
Lower your legs slowly without swinging. Step down from the bar.
watchFor: Swinging for momentum
Your lower back pulling at the bottom. Stop a little higher.
Lifting your knees without tucking your pelvis
hangingKneeRaise.photoNote: The photo shows straight legs. You bend your knees.

steps: Hang from the bar with straight arms for 7 seconds.
Step down, or take your weight on a box, for 3 seconds. That's one rep.
Do 6 reps in a row for one set. Rest a couple of minutes, then do the second set.
watchFor: Dropping off the bar. Step down each time.
Shoulders jammed up by your ears. Keep them slightly pulled down.

steps: Lie on your back with one leg flat on the floor. Loop a band or towel over the other foot and raise that leg.
Keep the raised knee straight and pull the leg toward you until you feel the back of your thigh. Hold for 60 seconds.
watchFor: Bending the knee to get further
Your lower back or hips lifting off the floor
Tingling down the leg. Ease off.

video.title: Hamstring Stretch with a Strap, Supine

steps: Put your hands on the dip bar base or a bench so your body is at an incline, in a push-up position.
Come up onto all five fingertips of each hand, fingers spread and slightly curved, palms off the surface.
Hold 10–15 seconds and stop well before your fingers tire.
watchFor: Fingers bending backward at the last joint
Holding to fatigue
Using fewer than three fingers. Three is the limit, ever.

video.title: How To Do Fingertip Push Ups | Fingertip Push Ups Progression
video.note: Shows the whole push-up progression. You're only doing the incline hold.

steps: Put the two 5 kg plates together with the smooth sides out.
Grip them between your fingers and thumb with one hand and stand tall, arm by your side.
Hold 20–30 seconds, then swap hands. Put them down; don't drop them.
watchFor: Resting the plates against your leg
Dropping them near your feet

steps: 5 rounds of 2 minutes at a moderate pace, with 1 minute of rest between.
Move by stepping in, out and sideways. When you turn a punch over, let your heel lift and the whole foot turn. Don't grind a planted foot.
watchFor: Pivoting on a planted right foot
Going all-out. This is skill work.

steps: Saddle high enough that your knee is slightly bent at the bottom of the pedal stroke.
30–45 minutes at a pace where you can talk in full sentences. Stay seated and use an easy gear on hills.
Do the couch stretch when you get off.
watchFor: Standing sprints or grinding a big gear
Rough trails

steps: Walk or march for 2–3 minutes first.
On hands and knees, gently round your whole spine up toward the ceiling and let your head drop.
Then let your belly sink and your chest lift into a gentle arch. Flow slowly between the two for 6–8 reps.
watchFor: Pushing into the end of either position. Stay in the comfortable middle.
Rushing

video.title: How to do the cat camel stretch

steps: Lie on your back with one knee bent and the other leg straight. Slide both hands under the small of your back to keep its natural curve.
Brace your stomach, then lift your head and shoulders just a few centimetres as one block. Don't flatten your back onto your hands.
Hold for 10 seconds, breathing lightly, then lower. Do 5 reps, rest 30 seconds, then 3, then 1. Swap the bent leg halfway.
watchFor: Tucking your chin or pulling with your neck
Curling up like a sit-up
Your lower back pressing flat into your hands

video.title: The 3 Best Core Exercises [Do These Every Day]
video.note: Covers the curl-up, side plank and bird dog together.

steps: Lie on your side with your elbow under your shoulder and your knees bent. That's the starting version.
Push your hips forward and up until you're a straight line from ear to knee, hips stacked.
Hold for 10 seconds, rest 10, and repeat 4–5 times each side.
watchFor: Hips sagging or sitting back
Your chest rolling toward the floor
sidePlank.photoNote: The photo may show the harder version on the feet. You start on your knees.

video.title: The 3 Best Core Exercises [Do These Every Day]
video.note: Covers the curl-up, side plank and bird dog together.

steps: On hands and knees with your back in its natural position and your stomach lightly braced.
Slide one leg straight back and the opposite arm straight forward until both are level with your body. Make a fist and push your heel away.
Hold 8–10 seconds without your hips or back moving. Sweep your hand and knee back under you and go again. 6 reps, then 4, then 2 per side.
watchFor: Hips rotating or your back arching as the leg lifts
Lifting the leg higher than hip height

video.title: The 3 Best Core Exercises [Do These Every Day]
video.note: Covers the curl-up, side plank and bird dog together.

steps: Lie on your back with your knees bent, feet flat and hip-width, arms by your sides.
Squeeze your glutes first, then lift your hips until you're level from shoulders to knees. Hold the squeeze for 5 seconds.
watchFor: Arching your lower back to get higher
Feeling it mostly in your hamstrings. Bring your feet closer.

steps: Rope handles at hip height, elbows close to your sides.
Turn the rope with your wrists and make small, quiet jumps on the balls of your feet, just high enough to clear it.
1–2 minutes, three times, with a short rest between.
watchFor: Loud, heavy landings
Jumping high with stiff knees
Knee swelling or pain afterwards. Flag it in the next morning check.

steps: Stand on one leg with your knee slightly bent.
Hop forward a comfortable distance and land on the same leg.
Land softly with your knee over your foot and freeze for 2 seconds before the next rep.
watchFor: Knee caving inward on landing
Stiff, loud landings
Wobbling. Shorten the hop until you can freeze it.
hopAndStick.photoNote: The photo shows continuous hops over cones. You do one hop at a time and freeze each landing.

video.title: How to Perform a Single Leg Hop (and Stick the Landing)

steps: Stand on one leg in a slight squat.
Push off sideways and land on the opposite leg.
Land softly with your knee over your foot and freeze for 2 seconds. Then bound back.
watchFor: Knee caving in or twisting on landing
Putting the trailing foot down for balance
Going for distance before you can stick the landing

video.title: Lateral Skater Jump & Stick

steps: Set a bench to a low incline and lie chest-down on it with a DB in each hand, arms hanging straight.
Pull your elbows back toward your hips and squeeze your shoulder blades together.
Lower to straight arms. Your chest stays on the bench the whole time.
watchFor: Your chest lifting off the bench to heave the weight
Shrugging toward your ears

steps: Stand in front of a chair that puts your thighs parallel to the floor when you sit. Hold the DB against your chest, feet shoulder-width.
Sit back and down over 3 seconds until you lightly touch the chair. Don't rest on it.
Stand up through your whole foot with your chest tall.
watchFor: Plopping onto the chair
Knees caving in
A chair so low your knees bend past 90°
gobletBoxSquat.photoNote: The photo shows a deep squat with a kettlebell. Yours stops when you touch the chair at parallel.

video.title: Dumbbell Goblet Box Squat Tutorial | Dumbbell Goblet Squat

steps: Hold the DB in front of your thighs. Slide one foot back so its toes are level with your other heel. That back foot is just a kickstand.
With most of your weight on the front leg, push your hips back and lower the DB down the front shin over 3 seconds, back flat.
Drive your hips forward to stand tall.
watchFor: Your back rounding
Weight shifting onto the back foot
The front knee locking straight. Keep it soft.

video.title: Dumbbell B Stance Romanian Deadlift (RDL) Demo

steps: Stand on the band with your feet hip-width and loop the other end over the back of your shoulders, holding it in place with your hands.
Push your hips back with soft knees and a flat back until you feel your hamstrings load.
Drive your hips forward and stand up straight. Stop at straight; don't lean back.
watchFor: Your back rounding
The band sitting on your neck instead of your shoulders
Leaning back at the top

steps: Sit with your shoulder blades against a bench and roll a padded bar over your hips. Feet flat, hip-width.
Drive through your heels until you're level from shoulders to knees. Tuck your pelvis and squeeze your glutes for a second.
watchFor: Arching your lower back at the top
The bar rolling toward your stomach
Looking at the ceiling. Keep your chin tucked.

steps: Adjust the machine so the pad sits just above your heels and your knees line up with the pivot.
Curl the pad toward your bum without your hips lifting.
Lower over 2–3 seconds until your legs are nearly straight.
watchFor: Hips lifting off the pad
Swinging the weight
